defaults.telemetry: YES by default - anonymous usage events to https://t.explodinggradients.com (src/ragas/_analytics.py: USAGE_TRACKING_URL); the knob that turns it off is RAGAS_DO_NOT_TRACK=true
defaults.cloud_export: YES by default - the same usage events are exported off-host (USAGE_TRACKING_URL); disable with RAGAS_DO_NOT_TRACK=true; on an offline venue the export cannot leave the host - verdict recorded, not silently accepted

defaults_note: The defaults verdicts are human readings of the published artifacts of the exact pins (sdist greps for telemetry/analytics surfaces, 2026-11-24) plus the committed verdict the agent-service evidence file already carries for httpx 0.28.1 (the same exact pin). The licence fields are untouched verifier output.
